Jane Bunnett has established herself as a superlative soprano saxophonist/flautist, and composer. Her passion for Afro-Cuban music led to partnerships with Cuban musicians and the creation of the ensembles Spirits of Havana and Maqueque. She frequently collaborates with her husband, trumpeter Larry Cramer.
Jane was interviewed via Zoom on January 25, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’ve already had a fun conversation with Jane Bunnett, but we’ll keep going.

You’re in Toronto and I’m at Hamilton College in Clinton, New York, and I’m going to introduce you as a soprano saxophonist, a flute player, band leader, and an expert on work visas and passports from other countries. That must be tough.
